body_excerpt:
Michał Majchrowicz and Marcin Wyczechowski discovered that Gzip's gzexe
utility created temporary files in an insecure manner when mktemp was
unavailable. A local attacker could possibly use this issue to overwrite
arbitrary files. (CVE-2026-41991)

Elias Hasas, Michał Majchrowicz and Marcin Wyczechowski discovered that Gzip incorrectly
handled certain compressed files. An attacker could possibly use this
issue to obtain sensitive information or cause Gzip to crash, resulting
in a denial of service. (CVE-2026-41992)
